item.title: Ten Minutes Fast
item.description:
A grieving chimney sweep is hired to clear every flue at a manor waiting for auction, and in the nursery he finds a clock that runs ten minutes fast. Tiny handprints in old soot and a penny whistle hidden in the brick suggest the clock isn't wrong at all, and that whatever it's counting toward is nearly here.
Read the story: https://echonoir.aportsolutions.co.uk/stories/2026-10-12-ten-minutes-fast/
This story was written by an AI model and narrated by a synthetic voice.

item.title: The Larkspur Cylinders
item.description:
A bell-ringer takes a garret in a fog-bound lodging house and finds a phonograph cylinder bearing his own voice, begging forgiveness for a drowning he never committed. Each night brings another recording, and every prophecy on them comes true.
Read the story: https://echonoir.aportsolutions.co.uk/stories/2026-10-20-the-larkspur-cylinders/
Genre: Gothic horror. Themes: gothic, ghost story, victorian, mystery.

item.title: The Fare to Nowhere
item.description:
Every night the app freezes for four seconds, and every night a silent passenger sits a little closer to the driver's seat. Douglas Whitlow has a cold flask, a dead address, and a growing suspicion that his rider has never wanted to arrive.
Read the story: https://echonoir.aportsolutions.co.uk/stories/2026-10-21-the-fare-to-nowhere/
Genre: Cosmic / weird horror. Themes: ghost story, taxi, supernatural, british fiction.

item.title: The Greywell Ledger
item.description:
A records clerk receives an unmarked parcel containing a small walnut television that glows only in the dark, and what it shows is her own stairwell. Each night the picture runs a little longer, and the woman on the screen looks more and more like someone she knows.

item.title: From the Black Wire Archive: The Ash-Tree
item.description:
In a damp Suffolk country house, a condemned woman whispers a promise on the gallows, and an old ash-tree keeps its own counsel beneath the moon. When the squire is found dead and blackened, something far stranger than poison may be at work.
Read the story: https://echonoir.aportsolutions.co.uk/stories/2026-11-05-the-ash-tree/
Genre: Classic ghost story. Themes: ghost story, m.r. james, witchcraft, gothic.
A public-domain story by M. R. James (1904), narrated by a synthetic voice, with sound design and artwork by Black Wire Tales. Text from Project Gutenberg (ebook 8486).
